title: 2007 AMC 12A Problem 13
statement: A piece of cheese is located at \((12,10)\) in a coordinate plane. A mouse is at \((4,-2)\) and is running up the line \(y=-5x+18.\) At the point \((a,b)\) the mouse starts getting farther from the cheese rather than closer to it. What is \(a+b?\)

solutions.text:
The mouse is closest to the cheese at the foot of the perpendicular from \((12,10)\) to the line.

This perpendicular has slope \(\tfrac15,\) so its equation is \(y=10+\tfrac15(x-12)=\tfrac15 x+\tfrac{38}{5}.\)

Setting \(\tfrac15 x+\tfrac{38}{5}=-5x+18\) gives \(x=2\) and \(y=8.\) Thus \((a,b)=(2,8)\) and \(a+b=10.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: The closest point on the line is the foot of the perpendicular from the cheese
The perpendicular through \((12,10)\) has slope \(\tfrac15\); intersect it with \(y=-5x+18\)
